description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'User' that validates whether an argument is a valid user, supporting UID or username, and optionally restricts users based on roles.

classes.name: Drupal"user\Plugin\views\argument_validator\User
classes.description: A plugin class for validating user arguments in Drupal views, supporting role restrictions and user identification by UID or username.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the User validator with entity type manager and sets up user storage.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines options for role restriction and selected roles.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring role restrictions in the argument validator.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Processes submitted form data, filtering out empty roles.

methods.name: validateEntity
methods.description: Validates if a user entity matches role restrictions.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies related to user roles.
